subject: Tidy LPA as a jamovi module

messages.author: 69ef3183c2197bc5
messages.subject: Tidy LPA as a jamovi module
parts:
Hi all,

Thank you for the development of a great R package! I have used it successfully in a report.

To draw more users to the package, I was wondering whether you would be fine with it, if I have make a Jamovi module from it (https://jamovi.org). A module is basically an R package with extra information in it, so people can interact with it via a GUI. I will include a reference to a publication from you. Users of the module are supposed to cite you.

Best,

Frank

messages.author: 3ab59aa560feab30
messages.subject: Re: Tidy LPA as a jamovi module
parts:
Dear Frank, I spoke with my co-developers, and we agree that making a Jamovi module would be useful and valuable. Thank you for asking about this - and please let me know how to help!
Josh
